property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the NotePreference (a Application).

property.name: noteColor
property.shortdesc: The note color, specified either as an array of three doubles, each in the range 0 to 255 and representing R, G, and B values, or as an InCopy UI color. Can return: Array of 3 Reals (0 - 255) or InCopyUIColors enumerator.

property.name: showNoteTips
property.shortdesc: If true, displays note information and some note content when the mouse pointer hovers over a note anchor in layout view or a note bookend in galley or story view.

property.name: findAndReplaceNoteContents
property.shortdesc: If true, includes inline notes content when using Find/Change commands (in Galley and Story views only).

property.name: spellCheckNotes
property.shortdesc: If true, includes inline notes content when using Spell Check (in Galley and Story views only).

property.name: noteColorChoices
property.shortdesc: The color to use for notes.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the NotePreference.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
